caption: The drawing depicts a single, light-colored garment, likely a dress, centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background. The object is rendered in delicate and soft shades of cream and beige, with some lightly defined shadows and outlines. The dress has a short sleeve design with ruffles at the shoulders, a rounded neckline, and a long, flowing skirt that extends downward. The bodice and front panel of the skirt, visible due to the angle, display diagonal pleating or ribbing, bordered by ruffled trims that run vertically from the neckline to the hem. The bottom edge of the dress also features a ruffled hem. The transparency of the material and the layering is subtly indicated by faint shading. There are no other objects or elements within the composition besides the dress and the plain background.
title: Infant's Dress (Back View)
